ResearchTabDef.label: CeleTech Foundry - Shuttle Expansion
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Research modular shuttle structure, onboard power, flight control, cargo systems, habitation, medical evacuation, shielding, and fire-control systems.

ResearchProjectDef.label: modular shuttle frame
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Develop modular shuttle structure and the basic interfaces needed to assemble shuttle segments and modules.
Unlocks: - Basic cockpit - Basic frame - Basic cargo segment - Basic control module

ResearchProjectDef.label: internal power bus
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Build shuttle-owned power distribution hardware for reactors, batteries, regulators, and onboard module demand.
Unlocks: - Reactor modules - Battery modules - Power regulators - Power segment

ResearchProjectDef.label: shuttle fusion power bus
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Unlocks compact fusion pulse reactor modules for high-output shuttle power systems.
Unlocks: - Fusion pulse reactor module

ResearchProjectDef.label: shuttle flight-control matrix
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Integrate shuttle navigation computation, drive control, and flight envelope coordination.
Unlocks: - Navigation computer - Flight-control modules - Propulsion control modules

ResearchProjectDef.label: cargo bay engineering
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Develop modular cargo bay structure, internal cargo regions, and shuttle loading support.
Unlocks: - Standard cargo segment - Cargo modules - Loading support modules

ResearchProjectDef.label: cold-chain cargo systems
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Adapt shuttle cargo bays for refrigerated logistics and low-temperature in-flight storage.
Unlocks: - Cold-chain cargo modules - Low-temperature storage modules - Refrigerated cargo segment

ResearchProjectDef.label: habitat support systems
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Engineer shuttle habitat modules for rest, meals, and short-duration living support.
Unlocks: - Habitat support modules - Living segment - Crew support units

ResearchProjectDef.label: landing stabilization systems
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Improve landing and launch stabilization for adverse shuttle flight conditions.
Unlocks: - Landing stabilizer module - Launch and landing assist systems

ResearchProjectDef.label: medical transport bay
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Outfit shuttle support bays for patient carriage, emergency comfort, and medical transport workflows.
Unlocks: - Medical transport bay - Medical bay modules - Casualty transport support units

ResearchProjectDef.label: shuttle prisoner containment
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Adapt shuttle living sections for secured prisoner transport.
Unlocks: - Prison cell module

ResearchProjectDef.label: mechanoid logistics interface
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Prepare shuttle support bays for mechanoid logistics and onboard charging infrastructure.
Unlocks: - Mechanoid logistics interface - Mechanoid charging modules

ResearchProjectDef.label: mobile fabrication bay
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Convert modular cargo or support space into automated mobile fabrication and processing bays.
Unlocks: - Mobile fabrication bay - Auto worktable module

ResearchProjectDef.label: shuttle hull plating
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Unlocks hull plating modules for modular shuttles. Hull plating adds a material-dependent armor layer and hull integrity buffer before the shuttle's main structure takes damage.
Unlocks: - Hull plating

ResearchProjectDef.label: surface shield matrix
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Develop hull-attached surface shield matrices and shuttle-owned shield recharge routing.
Unlocks: - Surface shield modules - Shield projection modules

ResearchProjectDef.label: shuttle zero-point power
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Unlocks zero-point vacuum reactor modules for extreme-output late-game shuttle power systems.
Unlocks: - Zero-point vacuum reactor module

ResearchProjectDef.label: weapon bay integration
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Integrate shuttle weapon bays, internal weapon mounts, and basic weapon control buses.
Unlocks: - Weapon bay modules - Weapon mount modules

ResearchProjectDef.label: fire-control radar network
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Coordinate advanced shuttle weapons through radar and fire-control systems.
Unlocks: - Fire-control radar modules - Advanced weapon control units

ResearchProjectDef.label: automatic ammo loading
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Develop shuttle weapon ammunition handling hardware for automated reload requests.
Unlocks: - Ammo loader module
